status: Post-gate focused method development; broad combinatorial screen rejected before execution; blind HER outcomes remain unopened.
purpose: Test one mechanism-led strategy in which experimental optical source tasks shape a molecular representation that safely corrects a target-only hurdle model in scaffold-separated OOD regions.
claim_guard: This development experiment can release at most one completely specified strategy to the still-unopened 96-molecule blind set. It cannot replace the failed direct scalar-injection gate, establish universal transfer, or prove prospective discovery.

aqueous_small_alcohol.role: solution-state expert adjacent to the methanol-water reaction medium

self_host_solid.rule: Solvent token exactly equals the chromophore token
self_host_solid.role: molecular-solid expert adjacent to the suspended photocatalyst phase

source_encoder.architecture: directed bond message-passing neural network with mean molecular aggregation
source_encoder.input: standard Chemprop v2 atom and bond graph features
source_encoder.loss: masked equally weighted Huber loss after source-task standardization
source_encoder.optimizer: Chemprop Adam with a two-epoch Noam-like warmup and cooldown schedule

development.dynamic_ood_definition: Within each scaffold-separated evaluation pool, the 40 percent with the lowest maximum Morgan Tanimoto similarity to that draw's labeled target molecules; ties are resolved by target-key SHA256.

target_hurdle_model.prediction: probability of nonzero HER multiplied by predicted log1p HER among positive training observations
target_hurdle_model.fallback: ordinary target-only random-forest regression if a training draw has fewer than five observations in either hurdle class

target_adapter.type: ridge correction of target-only out-of-fold residuals
target_adapter.selection: inner scaffold-group out-of-fold RMSE within each labeled target draw
target_adapter.nested_cross_fitting: For every outer adapter-validation fold, target residuals are regenerated using only that outer fold's training scaffolds; no residual target may depend on an outer held scaffold.
target_adapter.safe_fallback: zero correction weight is a valid selected model

source_reliability.primary: geometric mean of aqueous/alcohol and solid-state source support after linear scaling
source_reliability.use: multiply only the donor residual correction; never alter the target-only prediction

development_release_gate.abstention: If any condition fails, do not open blind outcomes.

reporting.experimental_unit: recipient molecule with canonical-scaffold separation between labeled training and evaluation
reporting.computational_replicates: draws and random seeds quantify sensitivity and are not treated as independent experimental samples
reporting.multiplicity: No development p values are interpreted as confirmatory evidence; all methods, budgets and scopes are reported.
reporting.blind_boundary: The blind HER file must not appear in any focused-development source code or input manifest.

compute.balam: one A100 allocation and 32 CPU cores
compute.intended_runtime: approximately one to four hours, dominated by source scaffold validation and 900 target hurdle evaluations
